newsitem.title: LEBANON: Leading shares mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Leading shares mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Leading shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Monday and brokers said they were concerned by a drop in the price and trade volume of Banque Audi.
Bank of Beirut continued its upward move to $5.0625 from its record high of $5. Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce rose to $22.25 from $22.
"I see BOB up to $5.5 in the coming few days," a broker who wished not to be identified, said. "BLC share is fairly valued".
Banque Audi fell to $28.375 from $28.6250 on a turnover of 606 shares.
"What is worrying is that there is no demand for the share on high prices at all. It is worrying," the broker said.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.50 percent to 191.78. The BLOM general index fell 0.31 percent to 1,114.72 and the LISPI general index climbed 0.05 percent to 96.33 percent.
Solidere shares were mixed although brokers believe they remain "the best buy on the market".
Solidere A shares held steady at $13.00 and B shares dropped to $13.1250 from $13.2500.
BSE turnover fell to 170,196 from 232,788 for a value of $1,999,239 against $2,733,994.
Some 37,000 Uniceramic shares were traded off the floor at $1.75. The shares had last traded at $1.5 last January.
There was no trade in the other two listed industrial firms -- Ciments Blanc and Eternit.
